name: proto-blocks/oit-two-col-header
title: OIT Two-Col Header
description: Industry / section page header. Auto-derived breadcrumb, industry icon above headline, supporting subtitle, large featured image on the right, giant background wordmark, and a scroll-triggered reveal. Light theme only.

wordmark.label: Background Wordmark
wordmark.help: Giant uppercase word that sits behind the layout. Leave empty to hide.

highlightWord.label: Highlight word/phrase in title
highlightWord.help: First case-insensitive occurrence in the title is wrapped in a red span.
